authorization_basis: Controller requested production exact-cache integration authority after independent BACKGROUND_TABLE_001 component review. Owner latest priority is the isolated T-indexed atomic-rate table component; this contract does not dispatch a worker or authorize simultaneous canonical writers.

activation.controller_sequence: Controller completes or reaches the stopping point of the prioritized T-indexed atomic-rate table component, then explicitly assigns this frozen unit to one lower-tier implementation worker. Contract creation alone starts no commands or scientific process.
activation.precondition: Before edits, recheck all frozen base pins and shared checkout status, confirm exclusive ownership of the two canonical source paths, and record controller dispatch with actual execution identity. A changed unrelated HEAD is allowed if pins remain equal. Any changed pinned input requires an authority amendment before execution; no silent rebase or retargeting.
activation.final_reviewer: A different fresh Astra reviewer who authored neither this contract nor its implementation receives the observed diff and raw outcomes.

authority.role: Scientific authority; contract artifact only, no implementation or execution

implementation.rule: Controller records transport-selected and observed identities independently. No Astra implementation fallback.

checkout.untracked_state: Existing untracked research artifacts remain; preserve all of them.
checkout.rule: Existing checkout only. No clone, worktree, stash, reset, clean, Git stage/commit/push, checkpoint migration or live-process signal under this authority.

frozen_base.typed_identity: Pins are immutable source/input identity at entry. Only the two explicitly allowed canonical files may change after entry; their candidate bytes receive new identity. Numerical parity is assessed by explicit bits/control, not by requiring old and new executable hashes to agree.

allowed_paths.rule: Do not alter any table benchmark artifact, atomic-table component, existing test file, Cargo manifest/lock, scenario/numerical/output contract, dispatcher, original executable, historical output or checkpoint. Existing integration-test scratch files must use TMPDIR inside this new subtree.

implementation_contract.change: Add private bounded exact-key memoization at the immutable AxbiBackground point_at_scale boundary. Preserve the original successful BackgroundPoint values and the entire direct numerical computation. Existing driver call sites, including ray/moments, then share repeated values automatically.
implementation_contract.key: Exact input a.to_bits() u64. No rounded keys, approximate comparisons, redshift keys, interpolation, quantization or extrapolation.
implementation_contract.eviction: Deterministic FIFO of successful insertions; hits do not reorder FIFO.
implementation_contract.errors: Never insert failed calls. Preserve validation order and exact ForwardError variant/tag for invalid scale, constructor, rate, geometry and domain inputs. No numerical error suppression or fabricated fallback values.
implementation_contract.immutability: Entries belong to exactly one immutable cosmology/a_ref/a_end/b_ref/q_ref/family/panels identity. Cache state is private. Cloning preserves numerical behavior and cannot enable stale entries after model replacement. Public mutability of the standalone benchmark Model is not copied.
implementation_contract.direct_reference: Retain the original point_at_scale computation as one unchanged private direct routine. Tests can select a cfg(test)-only bypass and clear/inspect test counters. Public production behavior has caching enabled; no new runtime solver/configuration mode is introduced.
implementation_contract.thread_and_api_compatibility: Retain existing public constructor/signatures and AxbiBackground Clone/Debug and GeometryBackground usability. Preserve existing Send/Sync compatibility; choose an ordinary std implementation without dependencies. Test controls/counters do not enter physical DriverState or science output.
implementation_contract.driver_changes: Only inline cfg(test) parity/profile helpers and, if unavoidable, minimal cache accessor wiring. No changed ray, transport, source, chemistry, adaptive acceptance, resource-accounting, residual or output arithmetic.
implementation_contract.unchanged_clock: Driver::tentative continues subtracting the exact same cumulative direct point times. Do not replace dt, alter log/exp expressions, reassociate H_ref calculations, cache separately recomputed origin geometry or add a stable-interval routine in this unit.
implementation_contract.forbidden: No Hermite/table integration; no physical/provider/closure/solver/tolerance/domain/quadrature/step-policy change; no baseline trajectory, new goal, cost reset or old-checkpoint resume.

tests.organization: Add inline cfg(test) modules background_exact_cache_tests in axbi_background.rs and axbi_driver.rs. Keep the profile test ignored during the normal cargo test run. Existing axbi_background and axbi_driver integration tests run unchanged.

background_bit_parity.model: Exact DriverConfig::baseline cosmology/domain with 4096 panels and the six frozen family/q cases.
background_bit_parity.corpus: For each case: exact a_ref=1/21 and a_end=0.2; the predecessor 128-point repeated and 128-point unique log-coordinate patterns; 257 distinct interior points scale(j,8192), j=1..257; replay endpoints and selected evicted/interior keys. Use the predecessor scale(j,n) endpoint formulas unchanged.
background_bit_parity.assertions: All seven BackgroundPoint float fields compare to_bits against the unchanged direct routine for every success, both cold and warm, on hits/misses/evictions. Verify capacity never exceeds256, FIFO miss after evicted key, and only successful calls insert.
background_bit_parity.errors: Compare exact direct/cache error variant/tag for NaN, +/-infinity, +/-zero, -1, one representable input just below a_ref and above a_end. Invalid inputs do not populate the cache.
background_bit_parity.isolation: Warm distinct +/-q, SameH/physical and distinct valid panel/domain background instances at the same a; verify each matches its own direct routine. Clone a warmed instance and verify original/clone behavior after independent eviction activity.
background_bit_parity.inversion: Compare direct-bypassed and cached point_at_time at origin, endpoint and midpoint time for q=0 and+0.01 PhysicalDensityFixed; compare all returned bits and invalid-time errors. No inversion algorithm change.

full_driver.initial_configuration: DriverConfig::baseline exactly, changing only q_ref and same_h to the six frozen cases. Preserve4096 panels, GL8, energy_subdivisions16, end_zbar4, local_target1e-5, initial_dln_a1e-4 and baseline provider/model choices. Persist the precise config and each initial/preaccepted test state.
full_driver.paired_walk: Construct direct-bypassed and cached Driver instances with identical initial state. For each case, call adaptive_step once on each, compare outcomes and complete state, and repeat only after a matched rejected comparison. Stop the case at its first accepted step, at first error/mismatch, or after20 paired comparisons. Require a successful step for all six; exhaustion/error returns HOLD without extending or changing controls.
bitwise_fields: all Ledgers floats and event arrays
actual cumulative-time-subtraction dt for each tentative trial
exact_control_fields: Result<bool,ForwardError> variant/value or exact error tag
full_driver.warm_replay: For all six cases, replay the stored preaccepted step once per direct/cache mode after intentionally warming the cache with the same point requests. Require the same result and complete numerical/control state as cold replay. At most12 additional adaptive calls.
full_driver.partial_trial: For PhysicalDensityFixed q=0,+0.01,-0.01, repeat from the initial state with only max_attempts=1 changed. One direct and one cached adaptive call per case must return the same cap error and leave identical state, attempt/RHS/comparison/reject counters. At most6 calls; do not change solver tolerances to manufacture rejection.
full_driver.checkpoint: For those same three physical cases, save the stored preaccepted state to unit-local scratch, load it into a newly cold cached instance, compare physical fields, then replay one paired step against the direct reference. At most6 calls. No historical checkpoint is read, rewritten or migrated.
full_driver.outputs: For paired states, call output_row into in-memory buffers with identical case labels and require exact agreement of the five CSV streams; compare every physical checkpoint field and ledger. Explicit candidate source identity remains separate from historical source identity.
full_driver.state_trace: Record per-case attempted/accepted/rejected/error outcomes, all actual trial/counter counts, compared-state digest as a compact supplement to fieldwise assertions, first differing field and exact float bits on failure. Digests do not replace fieldwise parity assertions.

tests.pass: Every targeted test passes with zero physical bit differences and exact control parity. A shared unexpected scientific error is not accepted as a successful full-driver parity fixture.

step_profile.executable: The exact release lib-test binary produced by the successful cargo test invocation, not a new scientific runner. Freeze its absolute path and SHA before transfer.
step_profile.case_scope: PhysicalDensityFixed q=0,+0.01,-0.01 only; each uses the exact local-test preaccepted checkpoint/config that already passed parity.
step_profile.operation: One full Driver::adaptive_step per mode per repetition, including its full-versus-two-half trial logic, gas/photons/ledgers and adaptivity. Read fixtures and construct instances outside the timed region; use fresh cold per-instance caches for each timed cached step. Record query/hit/miss counts so reuse is observed, not inferred.
step_profile.order: Even repetitions run direct then cache; odd repetitions run cache then direct. No warmup numerical steps or additional repeats.
step_profile.gate: Each repetition reproduces a successful matched step with all fieldwise parity assertions. First mismatch/error stops the profile and returns HOLD. There is no minimum speedup gate; a measured slowdown is reported unchanged.
step_profile.interpretation: Three same-host single-thread paired step measurements only. Source-derived repeated queries through ray/moments are not a measured full-history speedup; no64-core/scaling/trajectory claim.

commands.sequence: First run the complete targeted test command once. Only if it passes, build the production example once; do not execute that example. Only after both pass, transfer and run the single bounded profile lib-test executable.
commands.build_flags: Record actual rustc/cargo versions, target, profile and relevant existing environment. No fast-math, target-cpu=native, dependency/toolchain update or changed numerical optimization policy. Stop before building if inherited flags introduce an unreviewed numerical change.
commands.remote_environment: Set AXBI_EXACT_CACHE_EVIDENCE_ROOT to the remote unit root and TMPDIR to its tmp subtree, plus the three thread limits. Freeze actual argv/env/CPU/host before launch.
commands.remote_binding: Verify transferred executable, fixtures, candidate source manifest and contract hashes; confirm allowed affinity, >=10GiB free disk and output reservation. Use existing authorized NCP access and existing available tools. Do not install tools, profile/attach to old processes, or treat transfer success as completed execution.

limits.preparation_start: Record worker first preparation action time; include all commands that start. Do not reset the start after failure.
limits.count_note: The22 existing-test reserve comes from at most20 calls in component_step_doubling_and_state_array_metric and two calls in hard_caps_charge_started_trials_and_resume_without_off_by_one. It is a conservative reservation, not fabricated observed execution. Record actual new-fixture/profile counts separately.
limits.diagnostic_steps_only: The explicitly bounded adaptive calls are parity/profile component tests; no run() history, science launcher, baseline evolution or live continuation is authorized.
limits.stop: Stop at first compile/test/parity/identity/resource/transport failure, save raw first failure and current counts, and return HOLD. No automatic second test run, numerical change or remote retry. A repair requires separate authority and remaining limits; this contract does not guarantee a repair slot.

identity_outputs_and_accounting.new_identity: Recompute candidate compiled_identity using the changed source bytes and all17 canonical inputs; record per-file hashes, library/test/production example executable hashes, toolchain/flags and contract SHA. The lib-test comparator and production executable have different hashes and must be named separately.
identity_outputs_and_accounting.new_output_namespace: All new files stay under background_exact_cache_001 locally/remotely. If any later production run is separately approved, its output namespace must use its new executable/source identity; this contract launches no production run.
identity_outputs_and_accounting.historical_preservation: Leave old binaries, outputs, checkpoints, source_identity records, live processes and original allocations untouched. Do not present old32d11e733155 history as generated by the cache binary or pass old checkpoints through a new resume identity.
new_observed_records: raw build/test/profile logs and first failure
fixtures with exact configs and preaccepted states
identity_outputs_and_accounting.claim_relevant_receipt_fields: Both cargo invocation statuses/counts; source and executable identities; all case parity outcomes; actual adaptive/trial/RHS counters; per-step profile samples and medians; hit/miss counts; host/CPU/wall/RSS; first failure; cumulative goal accounting reference; requested/transport-selected/observed worker identity.
identity_outputs_and_accounting.accounting_rule: This is a new dependency node under the same goal and cumulative cost ledger. Its new explicit finite envelope never resets or reopens spent BACKGROUND_TABLE_001 limits; do not create a replacement goal/task/allocation to hide cost. No claim that query-call totals are comparable to adaptive-step totals.

claim_and_transition.retained_table_hold: SHORT_STEP_SUBTRACTION_HOLD remains. Cached direct subtraction reproduces its preexisting cancellation exactly; cache adoption is neither a clock repair nor table admission.
claim_and_transition.claim_ceiling: Exact memoization behavior and measured finite driver-step parity/performance only. No theorem, continuous background accuracy, physical-history convergence, AX11/AX12 PASS, full-goal speedup or scientific admission.
claim_and_transition.successful_execution_next_action: Send source diff, frozen identities, all raw results and cumulative accounting to a different independent Astra reviewer. Its scoped PASS can approve production cache adoption under a new identity, after which the controller selects the next already authorized execution/allocation. It cannot silently restart or relabel old live histories.
claim_and_transition.hold_next_action: Return the exact first failing field/coordinate/error or missing input. Keep failed evidence; independent READY atomic-table/baseline work continues under its own existing authority. No recursive optional process expansion.
claim_and_transition.publication: No Git publication or production launch under this contract. Those require the controller applicable owner scope and independent adoption decision.
